commentary: With market breadth at a fragile 44% and the macro gate flagged WEAK, the Nifty 50's consolidation near 25,144 reflects cautionary price action amid sticky inflation. Under the Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil frameworks, an uncertain market trend mandates defensive risk management, reduced overall exposure, and total avoidance of chasing extended stocks. Although record institutional inflows into capital goods provide underlying liquidity support, sub-50 breadth environments historically generate high breakout failure rates. Capital preservation requires demanding strict Stage 2 alignment, verified CANSLIM earnings acceleration, and unwavering execution of Minervini-style stop losses at the first sign of breakdown.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price satisfies the Minervini trend template above rising 50 and 200 SMAs, breaking out to a fresh 52-week high with RSI 69 showing unextended momentum. However, prolonged multi-year overhead churn and low institutional liquidity undermine breakout quality.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating margins remain wafer-thin at ~1.5%, with quarterly net profit expansion driven predominantly by non-operating other income rather than top-line leverage. Subdued ROE and negative 5-year sales CAGR fail O'Neil's CANSLIM institutional criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breakout thesis fails if price slips back below the base pivot; cut immediately at 104.62.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructing a solid base with two aligned swing lows applying pressure against the 514.61 pivot. Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are sequentially aligned, and MACD above zero confirms nascent Stage 2 momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 demonstrated operational turnaround with net profit up 81% and revenue expanding 27%, lifting EBITDA margins to 16.6%. Moderate leverage and double-digit ROCE support constructive institutional interest.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a rejection at 514.61 or breach of swing lows; execute stop at 454.95.

AARTISURF.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high on 3.15x average volume. The stock trades firmly above upward-sloping 50 and 200 SMAs with positive MACD momentum, exhibiting genuine institutional accumulation.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Delivered extraordinary earnings acceleration with Q2 net profit leaping over 700% YoY and sales expanding ~35%. Working capital cycle contraction and margin recovery offset historically modest ROE, meeting CANSLIM earnings explosion benchmarks.
AARTISURF.risk: Failure occurs if price slips back below the pivot; liquidate strictly at 580.74.

ABB.technical: Premier capital goods leader tightly coiling within 1.5% of its 7,706.70 pivot on 1.69x volume. Moving averages demonstrate classic Weinstein Stage 2 structure with price positioned comfortably above rising 50/200 SMAs.
ABB.fundamental: Pristine balance sheet with zero net debt, 29.9% ROCE, and 22.4% ROE. Record order book of ₹12,927 crore (+36% YoY) provides strong multi-year revenue visibility, though quarterly EPS growth remains modest at 8.2%.
ABB.risk: Setup fails if price drops below the 50-day average; exit cleanly at 7,291.91.

ABDL.technical: Tight consolidation holding within 1.5% of the 768.77 pivot on 1.45x volume. Price remains above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, but relative strength remains subdued versus leading market peers.
ABDL.fundamental: Displays healthy ROCE at 18.4% and ROE of 14.3%, but high debt (₹1,126 Cr) and elevated debtor days (168 days) weigh on balance sheet health. Single-digit revenue growth lags CANSLIM standards.
ABDL.risk: Pattern breaks down if price rejects pivot resistance; cut loss at 714.10.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: High-volume SEPA breakout clearing a 20-day high on 4.41x average volume, lifting RSI to 69. While short-term Stage 2 momentum is strong, technical extension requires disciplined risk management.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Maintains industry-leading operating margins exceeding 70% in port storage terminals. However, recent quarter net profit contracted -3.8% YoY alongside heavy capital expenditures and low ROE (~7.6%), failing CANSLIM earnings acceleration tests.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Breakout invalidates if price falls back below the trigger; execute stop at 293.63.
